title: Synthetic cohort generator assumptions (TICKET-07)
warning: Every value here is an input to the generator. None of it is a finding. Drop-off rates in the synthetic cohort are inputs, not findings, and are never presented as Nexyra results.

parameters.name: cohort_size
parameters.source: TICKET-07 scope (about 1,000 positive FIT cases)

parameters.name: random_seed
parameters.source: team choice: fixed so two runs give identical data

parameters.name: fit_window_days
parameters.source: team guess: FIT results are spread evenly over the 365 days before demo day 0 (17 Nov 2026)

parameters.name: age_min
parameters.source: team guess: screening age band, needs clinical review

parameters.name: age_max
parameters.source: team guess: screening age band, needs clinical review

parameters.name: dropoff_result_to_notified
parameters.unit: share of cases reaching the stage
parameters.source: team guess, calibrated with the other drop-offs so that the share reaching a colonoscopy is near the 30.5% anchor

parameters.name: dropoff_notified_to_referral
parameters.unit: share of cases reaching the stage
parameters.source: team guess, calibrated against the 30.5% anchor

parameters.name: dropoff_referral_unanswered
parameters.source: team guess: referral sent, receiving provider never answers

parameters.name: referral_rejection_share
parameters.source: team guess: receiving provider rejects the referral (for example insufficient data)

parameters.name: provider_change_share
parameters.source: team guess: patient moves to another provider, so the referral is rejected

parameters.name: rereferral_after_rejection
parameters.source: team guess: staff re-own the case and send a new referral; the rest stay unowned at 'patient notified'

parameters.name: max_referral_attempts
parameters.source: team guess: simplifying limit on the rejection loop

parameters.name: dropoff_accepted_to_booked
parameters.unit: share of cases reaching the stage
parameters.source: team guess, calibrated against the 30.5% anchor

parameters.name: dropoff_booked_no_show
parameters.source: team guess, calibrated against the 30.5% anchor

parameters.name: incomplete_procedure_share
parameters.source: team guess: examination incomplete, a new referral is needed

parameters.name: repeat_procedure_incomplete_share
parameters.source: team guess: a repeat examination that is again incomplete stalls the case

parameters.name: dropoff_performed_to_pathology_ordered
parameters.unit: share of cases reaching the stage
parameters.source: team guess: handover from the endoscopy unit is missed

parameters.name: dropoff_pathology_ordered_to_received
parameters.unit: share of cases reaching the stage
parameters.source: team guess: specimen or result lost between lab and programme

parameters.name: dropoff_pathology_to_closure_proposed
parameters.unit: share of cases reaching the stage
parameters.source: team guess: result sits without a closure proposal

parameters.name: dropoff_closure_proposed_to_confirmed
parameters.unit: share of cases reaching the stage
parameters.source: team guess: physician has not confirmed yet
